_comment: Dependency license policy, read by scripts/check-licenses.ts (run by .github/workflows/license-scan.yml and `pnpm check:licenses`). A package whose license is not on the list for where it runs, and has no exception below, is a finding. An exception needs a reason and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 12 months out); when it passes, the package is a finding again. `package` matches a name, or a prefix when it ends in `*`. Policy and reasoning: .github/SECURITY.md, 'How fast findings are fixed'.

exceptions.reason: Weak copyleft, used unmodified as a library in a hosted app we do not distribute, so its obligations on distributed copies are not triggered. Revisit if we ever ship the code to users.
Prebuilt libvips that sharp loads dynamically, unmodified, in a hosted app we do not distribute.
Fair Source: the only restriction is offering a competing product, which we do not; it becomes Apache-2.0 after two years.
Browser-support data, attribution only; permissive in effect.
Declares a bare 'BSD' with no clause count; a BSD-style permissive license, checked by reading the package license file.
Lint plugin that runs only on developer machines and in CI; nothing of it is in the production build.
Dependency of eslint-plugin-sonarjs; development only, not in the production build.
No license declared in the package metadata; a dependency of the dev-only vercel CLI, not in the production build. Re-check when the CLI upgrades.
